info.title: Emails
info.x-hubspot-api-use-case: You send and manage emails to your customers using a third-party email provider, and you want to programmatically log your email data to the associated records in your HubSpot account.
info.x-hubspot-introduction: Use the email engagements API to associate emails with records in your CRM. You can include various metadata fields as needed, including the email's headers, subject line, and body.

patch.summary: Partially update an email by ID.
patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{emailId}`. `{emailId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.
